Chapter 1125: Chapter 41 The Importance of Lin Yuan (Please Subscribe)

The height that life can reach largely depends on two aspects.

One is innate talent and aptitude.

The other is the influence of external forces.

Both are indispensable.

In fact, the latter may even be more important than the former.

Without external assistance, even with strong talent and aptitude, one would still take many detours.

Conversely, as long as there are enough external influences and aids, even with mediocre talent and aptitude.

The final achievement will not be much lower.

Talent and aptitude determine the upper limit.

While external influences determine the lower limit.

In King Chibao’s view, Lin Yuan’s bloodline reverts to his ancestors.

There’s no need to speak much about his talent and aptitude, it must be top-notch.

But in the absence of guidance from the many resources and inheritances of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s royal family.

If he can grow to the limit on his own, and even defeat and kill King Lingshen, who is also a core royal of the limit…

This is absolutely unprecedented; at least in the endless ages, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country has never produced such a prodigy.

In the past, there were some cases of the revival of ancestral bloodlines in ancient countries, eventually leading to a rise.

But here, ‘rise’ refers to being nurtured by the ancient country before rising.

And Lin Yuan?

Before today, King Chibao had never heard of the name Galaxy.

Lin Yuan had already risen without even contacting the royal family of the ancient country.

If growing to the limit of the core royal family is not considered a rise, what is? Moreover, Lin Yuan not only grew to the limit, but also just killed King Lingshen, who was also a limit royal family.

“Brother Galaxy, you possess the Yang Divine Body, a descendant of the Ancestor. Now I formally invite you to join my lineage of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s royal family…”

King Chibao composed himself and immediately invited.

Upon confirming that Lin Yuan was indeed a pure descendant of the Fierce Sun, King Chibao’s first thought was to draw him in.

To completely draw Lin Yuan to the side of the ancient country.

What a joke?

For such a prodigy, what do you wait for if not to draw him in?

If he were to be let go, King Chibao would probably regret it for billions or even a trillion years.

As for whether Lin Yuan’s identity would cause any issues… King Chibao didn’t think much about it.

First, the dense Fierce Sun aura emanating from Lin Yuan was not fake.

Second, what problems could arise? The Fierce Sun Country is one of the strongest forces in this realm, no matter what links Lin Yuan has, it can bear them.

These two points are enough.

“Join the lineage of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s royal family?”

Lin Yuan looked at King Chibao.

In fact, even without King Chibao’s remarks, Lin Yuan had planned to visit the capital of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country in a while.

The ancestor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country is a thirteenth-layer time life, and this is the only known thirteenth-layer force currently confirmed by Lin Yuan.

Of course, other ancient countries are not included in this scope.

In the Chaos Void, numerous Chaos Great Saints and supreme Great Saints are arduously seeking traces of thirteenth-layer time life.

Yet in this Fang Yuan World, is there a clear opportunity to contact them?

Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t miss it.

The hardest threshold for a complete twelfth-layer to breakthrough to the thirteenth-layer is passing through a time cycle.

And how to pass through the time cycle, whether there are any auxiliary means… the Eye of Myriad Laws frankly said there aren’t any.

Spreading one’s own path of evolution, strengthening anchor points and waymarks, technically speaking, isn’t an auxiliary means.

But the Eye of Myriad Laws is merely a secret treasure left by a thirteenth-layer time life, naturally incomparable to a true thirteenth-layer life.

The Eye of Myriad Laws saying there is no way doesn’t mean a true thirteenth-layer time life has no way.

Moreover, enhancing the potential to pass through the time cycle is still far off for Lin Yuan currently; his actual realm is only at the Dominator level.

Let’s not mention it for now.

There are many direct, visible benefits too, such as a massive amount of resources and inheritance.

The importance of resources is unquestionable, and so is inheritance.

“Infinite Void” is a thirteenth-layer inheritance, allowing Lin Yuan’s foundation to reach an immensely terrifying level.

The Ancestor of the Fierce Sun, as a thirteenth-layer time life, presumably also left a corresponding thirteenth-layer inheritance.

If Lin Yuan were to obtain it, it would undoubtedly enhance his own strength substantially, although breaking through to the thirteenth-layer is still far off, enhancing one’s foundation? That’s needed at any time.

“Brother Galaxy, most of this world’s strongmen, especially those Heavenly Venerates, choose to join one of the six major ancient countries. There’s nothing shameful about it.”

King Chibao said: “Leaving aside the other five major ancient countries, my Fierce Sun Ancient Country has the many inheritance treasures bestowed by the Ancestor. Those Heavenly Venerates wanting to go further? Relying on their own cultivation? How long would that take? Whether they can ultimately achieve it is also another matter.”

“But by joining my Fierce Sun Ancient Country, with a clear path to inheritance, it’s much easier.”

King Chibao looked at Lin Yuan and continued: “Some Great Lords are unwilling to be bound, so they don’t choose to join any ancient country, but the Heavenly Venerates? There’s almost no neutral Heavenly Venerates; they’ve all already aligned with one or another ancient country’s camp.”

“I know.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Like the Great Lord Hongye and Great Lord Fire Axe, they haven’t been ennobled by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

And this is already the limit for strongmen in the neutral camp; without joining any country, relying solely on a Great Lord’s own capabilities, the chance of stepping into a Heavenly Venerate is minimal.

Even if they happen to become a Heavenly Venerate, upon realizing that Heavenly Venerate cultivation is many times harder than that of Great Lords, they will naturally join one ancient country, seeking further progress.

“If Brother Galaxy is willing to join my royal lineage, I will personally report to His Majesty, and the nurturing Brother Galaxy receives will undoubtedly be top-notch.”

King Chibao immediately assured.

Unlike those Heavenly Venerates who joined allegiance, Lin Yuan’s ancestral bloodline is rich, reaching the level of the core royal, and is naturally bound to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

The royal family of the ancient country will certainly hold back when dealing with Heavenly Venerates who have joined allegiance, not cultivating them wholeheartedly, and even if they bestow inheritance, it won’t be the top-grade, most core inheritance.
